issues.where: left and center vortex, and the cloud deck beneath it
issues.what: the storm texture sits 1 px left of the approved frame, and the sunlit ridges are about 4 percent lower in local contrast
issues.fix: move that cloud texture right 1 px and restore the filament contrast on the ridges

issues.where: cells F, B, A, G, E, H, and the ridges in D
issues.what: native crops are off the approved windows: F is 2 px left, B, A, and G are 1 px left, E is 1 px up-left, and H is 1 px down-left. On D, F, and B the ridges are flatter, the crests are duller, and the near-blacks are slightly lifted
issues.fix: slide F right 2 px, B, A, and G right 1 px, E down and right 1 px, and H up and right 1 px, then restore ridge micro-contrast, lift the crests, and hold the blacks down

issues.where: Io, its shadow, and the Great Red Spot
issues.what: those features sit 1 px up and left of the approved frame, and the shadow edge and spot filaments are slightly darker and softer
issues.fix: move Io, the shadow, and the spot down and right 1 px, and bring the shadow-edge and spot contrast back

issues.where: cell A (Io, shadow, Great Red Spot) and cell I (banded disk)
issues.what: the same 1 px up-left offset, with a softer shadow edge and red-spot texture after alignment
issues.fix: shift both crops down and right 1 px and restore the shadow-edge and spot contrast

issues.where: sunlit limb, upper and outer halo
issues.what: the first 2 px outside the limb are hotter, and the halo from about 2 to 20 px is darker, so the glow dies early
issues.fix: pull the immediate rim down and widen and soften the outer falloff to the approved halo

issues.where: night-side cloud crests and blue discharges
issues.what: placement matches, but micro-contrast is low and the crests are slightly dull
issues.fix: restore fine crest contrast and discharge snap without moving them
